Class ViewGeometry

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.vision.ViewGeometry
public final class ViewGeometry extends Object
Camera maths in Minecraft's conventions: yaw 0 faces +Z and grows clockwise seen from above, positive pitch looks down. Screen coordinates are in units of half the frame height, x to the right and y up, which is what MaskExtractor reports.
